commencement.quote: The term of this Lease (the “Term”) shall commence on July 1, 2023 (the “Commencement Date”) and shall expire at 11:59 p.m. on June 30, 2028 (the “Expiration Date”), unless sooner terminated or extended in accordance with the provisions of this Lease.

escalation_amount.quote: Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date and on each anniversary thereafter during the Term, the Monthly Base Rent shall increase by $275.00 per month.

escalation_kind.quote: Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date and on each anniversary thereafter during the Term, the Monthly Base Rent shall increase by $275.00 per month.

proportionate_share_pct.quote: Tenant’s Proportionate Share is 4.84%, computed as the rentable area of the Premises divided by the rentable area of the Building.

renewal_count.quote: Provided no event of default is then continuing, Tenant shall have two (2) options to extend the Term, each for an additional period of 3 years, on all of the terms and conditions of this Lease except that Base Rent during each extension period shall be determined under Section 11.3.

renewal_notice_days.quote: Each option shall be exercised, if at all, by written notice delivered to Landlord not less than 180 days prior to the then-current Expiration Date.

renewal_years.quote: Provided no event of default is then continuing, Tenant shall have two (2) options to extend the Term, each for an additional period of 3 years, on all of the terms and conditions of this Lease except that Base Rent during each extension period shall be determined under Section 11.3.

rentable_sf.quote: The Premises are stipulated to contain 3,100 rentable square feet.

security_deposit.quote: Concurrently with Tenant’s execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of $18,300.00 as a security deposit for the faithful performance of Tenant’s obligations hereunder.

uncertain: Extension-period Base Rent (Section 11.3, page 7) is the greater of the final-month Monthly Base Rent and 95% of a fair market rental rate to be determined by Landlord and Tenant; the market rate is not stated, so extension rent cannot be computed and needs human review if an option is exercised.
